description: Export a project as one self-contained HTML file that plays offline in any browser (player with scrubber, chapters, keyboard controls; frames drawn live by the same runtime as the MP4).

autoplay_muted.description: start playing muted as soon as it loads (for embedding)

background.description: answer at once with a task id and keep working in the background; the status tool with {"task": id} reports progress and the result. Default false: wait for the result (a host with a short tool-call limit gets a task id after about 20 s anyway).

controls.description: player chrome: full (default), minimal, or none (for embedding)

folder.description: write a folder (index.html + assets/) for hosting instead of one file; output is then a folder

job.description: write into this job folder or job name (with output: that file name inside it)

output.description: output .html (default: a new showtime-out/ job folder)

target.description: file (default) or artifact (one file under 16 MB for sandboxed hosts)

name: export_html
title: Export an interactive HTML video
